verdict.rationale: Notion publishes an API reference under developers.notion.com/reference and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json returns HTTP 200). Its quickstart walks users through making a first API request in under two minutes, which shows documented reference material and example requests. There is no evidence that the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser. Missing for 10: an interactive 'try it' console in the reference, runnable in-doc examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
